content: Jin picked up a dry pine twig and drew a spiral in the frozen dirt. 'Southern Edge calculates swordsmanship along Newtonian linear vectors: Point A to Point B with maximum velocity. The Moon AI algorithm predicts this trajectory with ninety-nine point nine percent confidence. Mount Hua does not use lines. We use non-computable oscillatory loops.'
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Non-linear dynamic geometry, predictive algorithm counter.

content: Jin's twig traced the shape of a flower upon the frost-dusted ground. With each curve, the lines seemed to breathe, turning from geometry into song. He did not explain with words alone; his wrists moved with the fluid memory of water flowing around stone, turning hardness into petals.
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Poetic calligraphy, organic martial flow.

content: Jin poked Baek Cheon in the forehead with the twig. "Think with your gut, not your empty aristocratic skull! Southern Edge strikes straight like a charging pig! What do you do when a pig charges? You step aside and plant a branch in its rear! Watch!" He flicked the twig, creating three phantom arcs in the firelight.
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: Charging pig metaphor, twig poke, pure Mount Hua grit.
